premises.text: Chronic unpredictable blackouts disrupt homes and force businesses onto backup generators that cost about four times grid power
premises.evidence_span: it costs four times the amount to run a backup generator than it costs to get power from the grid

premises.text: Low-cost Android phones turned into community power sensors deliver real-time outage/restore push notifications, SMS access, and in-app outage reporting
premises.evidence_span: we take low-cost Android phones, just like this, and we turn them into power sensors to let our users know when there's power available in their community

premises.text: Primary customers are power companies that use the platform to communicate with customers, with additional bill-pay and data opportunities
premises.evidence_span: our main customers are the power companies, and they can use our platform to communicate directly with their customers

premises.text: African electricity demand shortfalls plus rapid smartphone growth create a large market for a power communications platform
premises.evidence_span: the electricity market in Africa is a $27 billion market. And they're only producing 50% of the power that people actually need

value.text: Real-time power outage communications that help people and utilities adapt to blackouts
value.evidence_span: We provide real-time power outage notifications

causal_links.evidence_span: imagine what businesses could adapt to with a little more predictability
she'll get a push notification that the power has been restored
SOP Notify will become the number one power communications platform in Africa

notes: Household disruption and generator cost/infrastructure failure folded as one blackout-pain set (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). Push/SMS/report-line demo folded into sensor platform mechanism (§4.1.7). Idibadan pilot treated as traction evidence of utility GTM, not a separate premise. Anti-template: problem, product, and utility/market GTM separately revisable.
